spec.css: kit-primitives.css section 10 (the only place button rules live)
spec.systems: <a|button class="kit-btn …"> and the core Button block render the same

primary.use: the main action; one per area
primary.dark: takes the brand pair (fill and hover), since ink would vanish

secondary.use: other actions next to a primary
secondary.light: soft grey fill (6% ink), 1px --kit-color-line outline, ink text; hover ink fill
secondary.dark: soft white tint (12%), 60% white outline, white text; hover white fill, ink text

ghost.use: an outlined action with more weight than Secondary
ghost.light: ink outline, ink text; hover ink fill, white text
ghost.dark: white outline, white text; hover white fill, ink text

brand.use: brand moments: the primary shape in the brand colour
brand.colour: --kit-btn-brand-bg/-fg: the site's brand (yellow, ink text), or the campaign's own colour inside a campaign palette (.aw-camp--<name> sets the pair)
brand.light: brand fill; hover = brand mixed with ink (--kit-btn-hover-mix)

states.hover: primary lightens; secondary fills with ink (white on dark); ghost gets a tint; brand darkens towards ink (--kit-btn-hover-mix); colours fade over --kit-motion-fast; the icon nudges (spring, --kit-duration-spring); pointer devices only
states.focus-visible: --kit-focus-width ring in --kit-color-focus at --kit-focus-offset; colours unchanged; the icon nudges as on hover
states.disabled: disabled attribute (buttons) or aria-disabled="true" (links, which then do not navigate); --opacity-disabled; no hover, no press
states.loading: class is-loading or aria-busy="true": spinner in place of the icon, label stays, no clicks

content.icon + label: the default. A function icon before the label (tel:, mailto:, WhatsApp, form submit and download automatic; or kit-btn--ico-<name>, or a .kit-ico span); otherwise → after the label, ↗ when the link leaves the site
content.label only: kit-btn--label: a button with no icon (no arrow, no function icon); an explicit choice on any button
content.icon only: kit-btn--icon: square (height × height); <button> needs aria-label; on the core block the button text is the accessible name and is hidden on screen

spec.motion: colours fade --kit-motion-fast; icon nudge spring 3px (→), 2px diagonal (↗), leading icon 2px + scale 1.06; press 1px; spinner 700ms; prefers-reduced-motion: no transitions, no movement, spinner still at 60%
rules: a link styled as a button is never a heading, and a heading is never styled as a button
the underlined text link (kit-ed-more) is a link, not a button: only for "see all" links in a section head
block styles set the variant; size and content are extra CSS classes, so a button can be e.g. small secondary icon-only
spec.elements: every button is a link (<a>), except form buttons (<button type=submit>: Send, Subscribe, Search), which share the same classes
spec.forms: form buttons use the default height (--kit-btn-height = --kit-size-control, 48px), the same as fields (--kit-field-height), so a field and its button line up
